blind.description: A stylized wooden alchemy crafting table featuring a double-tiered hutch shelf at the back loaded with assorted small corked potion bottles in red, green, orange, and cream. The main tabletop holds a large round green flask on a metal burner stand, a red glass alembic retort connected to an orange flask, a stone mortar and pestle, and an open book. Below the main counter, a lower shelf holds a wooden storage box and two additional round potion jars. All geometry is solid, stylized, and cleanly modeled without gaps, floating pieces, or melted regions.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden workbench top with a neat row of colorful jar corks and lids along the rear shelf, next to a large circular green vessel, a teardrop-shaped red retort extending into an orange receiver, a dark circular mortar, and a small open rectangular book.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4 feet wide.
